# EHS Simplified — home of Agentic EHS
> CSP-led safety for leaders who got handed safety on top of their day job. Agentic EHS is AI-powered EHS software that drafts written safety programs, training, inspections and a daily safety plan, with a Certified Safety Professional (CSP) checking the work and on call. Plans from $449/month, all software included, 14-day free trial.

EHS Simplified, LLC is led by Aaron Leff, CSP (25+ years in EHS). Its software, Agentic EHS, serves companies from a single small shop to several sites: the operations, HR or plant manager or owner who carries safety duties without a safety background, the in-house safety professional running a department of one, and multi-site companies. Nothing the AI drafts is final until a named person approves it.

## What Agentic EHS Does
- Drafts written safety programs for the customer's site, approved by a named person
- Builds employee training with pictures, quizzes, sign-offs and records
- "My day": lays out each morning's safety work, desk work and floor work
- Inspections, hazard and close-call reporting, and corrective actions
- Ergonomic assessments from a phone photo, with a risk score and ranked fixes
- Compliance calendar, SDS library, risk assessments and injury logs
- Escalate to a CSP from any screen, with a CSP time meter (no surprise bills)
- Workers are free and unlimited; anyone can ask a safety question

## Who It's For
- Leaders who got handed safety: operations, HR or plant managers and owners
- In-house safety professionals working as a department of one
- Companies with several sites
Built for real work: machines and equipment, chemicals, lifting and vehicles.

## Pricing (all software included; 14-day free trial; workers always free)
- Essentials — $449/month ($4,490/year): 1 CSP hour/month, answers within 2 business days, 3 manager seats, 1 site
- Professional — $849/month ($8,490/year): 2 CSP hours/month, next-business-day answers, 10 manager seats, 2 sites
- Multi-site — $1,695/month ($16,950/year): 4 CSP hours/month, same-business-day answers, 25 manager seats, 5 sites
- Enterprise — custom pricing: more sites and seats, a dedicated CSP, agreed response times
- Extras: manager seat $25/month, site $150/month, CSP hour $195. On-site projects quoted separately.
